title: Basalt bas-relief carrying hermetic teachings

tellings.quote: you is a giant Basalt what's called a b relief and it is this massive 3ot by 3ot by 4ot stone column uh block that has all these sacred teachings that literally became what I think is the basis of hermeticism itself

plain: Near Lake Van in Turkey, there is said to be a huge carved stone block made of basalt, a dark volcanic rock, about 3 feet by 3 feet by 4 feet, with sacred teachings carved into it in relief. The researcher Matt LaCroix describes it to Michels without naming a source. He says he thinks these teachings became the basis of Hermeticism, an old body of mystical and philosophical writing, which would mean that tradition is far older than people usually think.
